CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Painting and Mosaic: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Mosaic.
   B. Practise Painting and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Painting and Mosaic.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Mosaic.

3. Best practice when working on Football: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Football.
   B. Damage equipment used for Football.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Football.
   D. Practise Football with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   C. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.

5. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   C. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   D. Practise Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. Only the costume
   C. The ticket price
   D. The speed of the music

8. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

9. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

10. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   C. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.

11. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.

12. Best practice when working on Puppetry: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Puppetry with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Puppetry.
   C. Damage equipment used for Puppetry.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Puppetry.

13. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   C. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.

14. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rounders.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.
   C. Practise Rounders with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rounders.

15. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.
   D. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Fabric Decoration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Puppetry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts Works 15 Total Number of Lessons 180 NOTE: The suggest and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
